leafIntegration.boundedFinding: The committed focused suite names atomic activation, exact LKG restore and stale, tampered, interrupted, cross-volume and unowned-state denials.
The committed focused suite binds exact passages and complete provenance to immutable editions and denies network, model, authority and stale-state paths.
The committed profile is default-off with a read-only mounted synthetic source, separate lifecycle/index volumes and no network; its focused host-Docker test remains an authoritative controller gate.

The manifest declares an offline synthetic fixture and a metadata-only official shape; preflight and synthetic reports retain empty pilot claims unless a later operator-mounted source satisfies the mounted path.

A future input-only ZIM reader may be ACCEPTED only by reusing the existing edition, lifecycle and receipt contracts; no ZIM importer, parser, downloader or second state owner is implemented or accepted.
